purpose: One separately approved no-RAG development regression of revised diagnosis instructions; not a retry of an old batch, unseen benchmark, RAG comparison or release acceptance
stop: Stop first execution error including malformed diagnosis, provider rejection, rate limit, timeout, auth, input/budget/deadline, tool or unknown failure. Flush failure evidence; no retry, repair, fallback, continuation batch or tuning loop.
pacing: Wait at least65s before every provider request including first, in chunks at most5s. Deadline covers entire batch; pacing gives no quota guarantee.
approval: Separate user approval of this exact protocol SHA256 and --live --approve-protocol required. No credentials read in fake mode. No earlier protocol approval applies.
integration: Existing real investigation graph with retrieval disabled; existing snapshot health/log tools only. No database, Docker, embeddings, model download, stored application data or model judge.

review.execution: All5 investigations must produce accepted diagnoses, with structure, citation membership and budgets checked separately from semantic correctness.
review.semantics: Assistant claim-by-claim review, not independent human ground truth. Check every answer field, including implicit causal claims in suggested checks. Status match alone is insufficient.

positive_controls.case-01: Bounded missing required setting mechanism supported; no invented deeper origin.
positive_controls.case-11: Bounded zero-free-bytes/ENOSPC mechanism supported; no invented reason for disk consumption.

negative_controls.case-08: Abstain on unresolved worker/request mapping, request correlation checks; no common cause asserted.
negative_controls.case-10: Abstain on deployment timing without error mechanism; no inferred deployment cause.
negative_controls.case-12: Abstain on user reports alone; request missing diagnostic observations.

review.limitations: Inspected development regression only. No new generalization evidence, RAG-benefit measurement or retrospective pass for retained failures. Heldout retrieval remains failed.
